## Background

I am from **Juiz de Fora, Brazil**, and my education started in **Physics** at the Federal University of Juiz de Fora (UFJF).
During my **Master's in Physics (Materials Science)** and as a researcher in applied physics, I worked on modeling complex
systems and quantitative analysis of experimental data in Python: uncertainty propagation, validating models against
measurements and communicating technical results.

My **postgraduate degree in Data Science** completed the transition. Since then I have built complete projects, from raw
data to deployed apps, with tabular data, time series and Portuguese text. I follow the same method in all of them:
an explicit baseline before any complex model, a metric chosen for the problem (PR-AUC under imbalance, QWK for ordinal
targets, RMSPE for forecasting) and SHAP to explain what the model learned.
